# frames

> Framed figures for docs, dashboards and write-ups. Three styles (plot, stub, tui), ten themes, plain CSS and one optional script. No build step, no framework.

## Install

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://crwl.tech/frames.css">
<script type="module" src="https://crwl.tech/frames.js"></script>
```

The stylesheet alone renders every figure. The script adds dragging, punching, zone readouts, row selection and live graphs.

## Options

- Theme: `data-fr-theme` on any ancestor. One of paper, graphite, phosphor, blueprint, riso, moss, signal, ultraviolet, rosewater, glacier. Without it, paper in light mode and ultraviolet in dark mode.
- No motion: `data-fr-static` on any ancestor. Reduced-motion users get this automatically.
- Values: `style="--fr-value: .62"` sets a 0 to 1 value. `data-fr-input` makes it draggable. `data-fr-max` and `data-fr-unit` set the label, written into any `[data-fr-label]` in the same figure.
- Events: `fr-input` (value), `fr-toggle` (hole punched), `fr-select` (table row), `fr-pause` (graph). All bubble.

## Figures

### plot-callouts

```html
<figure class="fr-plot">
  <ol class="fr-callouts">
    <li><span>caller stops talking</span><span>0 ms</span></li>
    <li><span>speech-to-text final</span><span>180 ms</span></li>
    <li><span>model first token</span><span>420 ms</span></li>
    <li><span>first audio out</span><span>610 ms</span></li>
  </ol>
  <figcaption class="fr-plot-block">
    <span>fig 01</span><span>turn stages</span>
    <span>rev a</span><span data-fr-zone>zone ·</span>
  </figcaption>
</figure>
```

### plot-dimension

```html
<figure class="fr-plot">
  <div class="fr-dim" style="--fr-value: .7625" data-fr-input data-fr-max="800" data-fr-unit="ms" aria-label="Latency spent">
    <span data-fr-label>610 ms</span>
  </div>
  <figcaption class="fr-plot-block">
    <span>fig 02</span><span>latency budget</span>
    <span>max</span><span>800 ms</span>
  </figcaption>
</figure>
```

### stub-checklist

```html
<figure class="fr-stub">
  <button type="button" class="fr-stub-side"><span><b>no. 0417</b> launch</span></button>
  <div class="fr-stub-body">
    <div class="fr-stub-head"><b>launch checks</b><span data-fr-count>3 of 5 punched</span></div>
    <ul class="fr-holes">
      <li><button type="button" aria-pressed="true">dns records live</button></li>
      <li><button type="button" aria-pressed="true">tls certificate issued</button></li>
      <li><button type="button" aria-pressed="true">health check green</button></li>
      <li><button type="button" aria-pressed="false">rollback rehearsed</button></li>
      <li><button type="button" aria-pressed="false">status page linked</button></li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</figure>
```

### stub-punch

```html
<figure class="fr-stub">
  <button type="button" class="fr-stub-side"><span><b>no. 0418</b> disk</span></button>
  <div class="fr-stub-body">
    <div class="fr-stub-head"><b>volume used</b><span>512 GB</span></div>
    <div class="fr-punch" style="--fr-value: .62" data-fr-input data-fr-max="512" data-fr-unit="GB" aria-label="Volume used"></div>
    <p class="fr-stub-head"><span>drag to punch</span><b data-fr-label>317 GB</b></p>
  </div>
</figure>
```

### tui-table

```html
<figure class="fr-tui">
  <figcaption class="fr-tui-title"><sup>1</sup>services</figcaption>
  <span class="fr-tui-meta">p95</span>
  <table class="fr-procs">
    <thead><tr><th>name</th><th>ms</th><th>trend</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>speech-to-text</td><td>182</td><td>▃▄▃▅▄▃▄▃</td></tr>
      <tr aria-current="true"><td>model</td><td>241</td><td>▅▆▅▇▆▅▄▅</td></tr>
      <tr><td>text-to-speech</td><td>188</td><td>▂▂▃▂▂▃▂▂</td></tr>
      <tr><td>carrier</td><td>46</td><td>▁▁▂▁▁▁▂▁</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  <span class="fr-tui-keys"><kbd>j</kbd>/<kbd>k</kbd> select</span>
</figure>
```

### tui-graph

```html
<figure class="fr-tui">
  <figcaption class="fr-tui-title"><sup>2</sup>turn latency</figcaption>
  <span class="fr-tui-meta" data-fr-now>610 ms</span>
  <pre class="fr-braille" data-fr-live data-fr-rows="4" data-fr-max="800" data-fr-unit="ms" data-fr-series="0.62,0.6,0.64,0.66,0.61,0.58,0.55,0.57,0.6,0.63,0.67,0.7,0.68,0.64,0.6,0.58,0.62,0.66,0.69,0.72,0.7,0.66,0.61,0.57,0.55,0.58,0.62,0.65,0.63,0.6,0.58,0.61,0.64,0.68,0.71,0.73,0.7,0.67,0.63,0.6,0.59,0.62,0.66,0.7,0.74,0.76,0.73,0.69,0.65,0.62,0.6,0.63,0.66,0.69,0.67,0.64,0.62,0.65,0.68,0.7625">⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⢀⠤⡀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠐
⡀⠀⠀⠀⡠⠉⠢⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠠⠊⠉⠢⡀⠀⠀⠀⡐⠁⠀⠐⢄⠀⠀⠀⡠⢄⠀⠀⢀⠁
⠐⢄⢀⠊⠀⠀⠀⠑⡀⠀⢀⠌⠑⢄⢀⠔⠁⠀⠀⠀⠐⢄⣀⠌⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠢⠤⠊⠀⠀⠑⠔⠁⠀
⠀⠀⠁⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠐⠒⠁⠀⠀⠀⠁⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀</pre>
  <p class="fr-gauge"><span>used</span><span class="fr-gauge-bar" style="--fr-value: .7625" data-fr-input data-fr-max="800" data-fr-unit="ms" aria-label="Budget used"></span><span data-fr-label>610 ms</span></p>
  <span class="fr-tui-keys"><kbd>space</kbd> pause</span>
</figure>
```
